OpenRouter is officially part of @stripe today!
More than 10 million developers and companies use OpenRouter, and as they build with more models across more workloads, they need control over what it costs and where their data goes.
OpenRouter has built that operating infrastructure to help run AI across every model and provider, with access to new models, uptime through outages, and enforced spend and data policies for each team.
Joining Stripe, which has spent years running critical infrastructure for businesses around the world, means we can build it faster and support companies at every scale.
Our commitment to neutrality stays the same. Models and providers compete on quality, reliability, and price. You decide what works for your business.
Stripe (@stripe)
OpenRouter is now part of Stripe.
Stripe is building the economic infrastructure for AI. Together with OpenRouter, we’ll help businesses explore new models and optimize token routing and usage.
— https://x.com/stripe/status/2120240651778355306

世界中の企業の重要なインフラストラクチャを何年にもわたって運営してきた Stripe に参加することで、より迅速にインフラストラクチャを構築し、あらゆる規模の企業をサポートできるようになります。

Starting today, chat models on Hugging Face run through OpenRouter!
Open-weight models went from 27% to 72% of tokens on OpenRouter in under a year. A lot of that comes from two things: labs publishing their weights on Hugging Face 🤗, and dozens of providers competing to serve them on diverse dimensions.
Today we’re connecting the two. Chat models on the Hub now run through OpenRouter’s routing: 160 models from 38 labs, best provider picked per request, automatic failover, same HF token.
And your OpenRouter traces can now land in a Hugging Face bucket you own, ready for fine-tuning.
Excited to build this with @ClementDelangue, @julien_c, and the @huggingface team. More coming!
OpenRouter (@OpenRouter)
Open models on @huggingface now run through OpenRouter.
Each request goes to the provider with the best price, speed, and uptime for that model, with automatic failover. Everything runs on the same Hugging Face token and API.
You can also send your traces to Hugging Face Storage with Broadcast, so your requests live on the Hub next to your models, ready for things like evals or fine-tuning.
— https://x.com/OpenRouter/status/2122392434198131005
items.title_ja:
本日より、Hugging Face のチャット モデルが OpenRouter を介して実行されます。
オープンウェイト モデルは、1 年以内に OpenRouter 上のトークンの 27% から 72% に増加しました。その多くは 2 つのことから来ています。1 つは Hugging Face 🤗 で重みを公開しているラボ、もう 1 つはさまざまな側面で重みを提供しようと数十のプロバイダーが競争していることです。
今日はその2つを結びます。ハブ上のチャット モデルは、OpenRouter のルーティングを通じて実行されるようになりました。38 のラボからの 160 のモデル、リクエストごとに選択される最適なプロバイダー、自動フェイルオーバー、同じ HF トークン。
また、OpenRouter トレースは、所有する Hugging Face バケットに到達し、微調整の準備が整います。
@ClementDelangue、@julien_c、@huggingface チームと一緒にこれを構築できることに興奮しています。さらに登場!
オープンルーター (@OpenRouter)
@huggingface のオープン モデルが OpenRouter 経由で実行されるようになりました。
各リクエストは、自動フェイルオーバーを備え、そのモデルに最適な価格、速度、稼働時間を提供するプロバイダーに送られます。すべてが同じ Hugging Face トークンと API で実行されます。
ブロードキャストを使用してトレースを Hugging Face Storage に送信することもできるため、リクエストはモデルの隣のハブに保存され、評価や微調整などの準備が整います。
— https://x.com/OpenRouter/status/2122392434198131005

🤗 Run OpenRouter inference directly on Hugging Face
🔓 Access Open model weights directly from OpenRouter
🤖 Store your OpenRouter agent traces on HF to inspect them, train better models or share them with the world!
More collaboration. Fewer zero-sum games. More power to AI builders. Let’s build! 💛💛💛

ElevenLabs has launched Scribe v3 Live Medical.
It is a model specialized in transcribing medical conversations as they happen, with a focus on getting drug names and procedures right.
According to ElevenLabs, those are the words that previously required the most correction. At the same time, care teams can still check every note written by the AI agent.
In ElevenLabs' tests, it made up to 48% fewer errors on medical terms with a custom term list loaded.
ElevenLabs (@ElevenLabs)
Scribe v3 Live Medical brings medical transcription to live calls.
It helps voice agents get medications, procedures, and symptoms right, and teams can add up to 10,000 of their own terms, like provider and drug names.
Now in ElevenAgents.

Genesis AI has raised a $500M Series A at a $3.5B valuation to build robots specialized in careful hand work.
The company built its robot starting with the hand to closely match a human hand, allowing it to learn and mimic how people work.
People teach it new skills by wearing a sensor glove while doing the task, which records how their hand moves and how hard it presses.
Zhou Xian (@zhou_xian_)
Genesis is entering its next phase.
Today we've raised a $500M Series A at $3.5B.
We can imagine far more than we can build physically today. Almost everything we are creating is still paid for in human time, by human hands. We want to remove the physical limits on human ambition.
We are building general-purpose robots with human level intelligence and capability. Ones that work reliably across entire workflows for years.
There are countless versions of possible futures where billions of robots are deployed everywhere, and we aspire to bring the brightest one that carries our hopes into reality.
